body:
Central Windows test runs: keep the private test temp prefix SHORT. Fixture Git calls under a long prefix fail before any assertion.
Two occurrences on 2026-11-16:
1. Sol-c593, 5c8b, test-195aef74. git init failed with exit 128, "Filename too long": the sample hook paths reached 261 characters. A short .tmp/w5/t prefix (239 characters) worked.
2. Sol-d50d, w-2b87 landed-closure run, test-d03c5c70. git worktree add failed with exit 128, "'$GIT_DIR' too big": the repo and worktree paths were 194 and 219 characters. The short .tmp/r13196/t prefix worked in a paired Git-only check.
RULE for Windows GOs: point TEMP, TMP, TMPDIR and TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP at a short in-repo prefix such as C:/github/Personal/TermAl/.tmp/<short>/t, outside the inspected worktree. A failure of this kind is an environment or setup cause. The corrected run is a setup correction, not a retry; it still gets its own named window.
